findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed multiple boxes of food in the back storage area and front service area to be stored directly on the floor. PIC was informed that food items need to be stored a minimum of 6 inches off the ground to prevent contamination. Ensure food is stored off the floor before the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed that the water in only employee restroom does not get hot. 5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. Repair or replace faucet so that the water reaches at least 100F according to code.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors throughout to be soiled. Snack aisle has loose snacks that appear to be cheese balls. Back food storage area has soil and food soil from spilling liquid dripped on the floor. 6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 
Clean and maintain clean.
